newsitem.title: USA: Picturetel sees Q1 results below estimates.
newsitem.headline: Picturetel sees Q1 results below estimates.

text.p: PictureTel Corp said Thursday it expects revenues and earnings for the first quarter to be "somewhat lower" than analysts' estimates.
It said it expects revenues of $120 million, up from $105 million a year earlier. It gave no earnings projection. A year ago it earned $7.5 million, or $0.21 a share.
The company did not specify any analysts' estimates.
PictureTel said it expects to release its final results for the first quarter, ended March 29, on April 16.

PictureTel said overall unit shipments were strong in the quarter, but the average selling price of its various videoconferencing systems was lower, due in part to increased demand for newer, lower-priced products and changes in overall product mix.
It also reported softening demand in the United States, although international sales continued strong.
Norman Gaut, chairman and chief executive officer, said the company remains confident about the future but is surprised and disappointed with the first quarter results.
